name: All Access (Complete Edition)
regional_pricing_note: Play price template auto-converts from $6.99 USD; keep .99 endings; accept Play's lowered IN/BR/ID tiers; never manually price US below $6.99 outside PW01
rc_offering: default (current); also packaged in shop and bonus_district
placement_context: post_level_5 (RC Paywall v2) + bonus_district lock + shop
contents: Night Harbor bonus district (10 levels) + Sakura theme + Neon theme + extra daily free rewind (2/day total vs 1/day base) + permanent removal of all non-rewarded ad surfaces + gold conductor badge
player_value_prop: One purchase, the whole game forever - no subscription, no energy, nothing held back
first_shown: Celebratory dismissible paywall after first Level 5 win; never after a failure
policy_notes: Play one-time promo codes verified working for one-time in-app products (2026-07-31) - this is the judge-access path; paywall must list contents explicitly per Play policy; raised because (a) downside is bounded (~$40 net base-case) with a 28.6% conversion-loss cushion, (b) $4.99 breaks the ladder — the everything-tier would price below its own two themes ($5.98) and tie cm_rewind_20, the decoy-confusion grounds on which the theme bundle was cut, and (c) the verified $7.26 casual D90 ARPPU shape supports a ~$7 completion price. The Grand-shortlist revenue argument is immaterial at our scale.
experiment_priority: PW01/E07 price + PW02/E06 timing + PW03/E12 framing (top of queue)
award_relevance: HAMM + Grand Prize (revenue) + Best Game monetization fit

name: Supporter Pack
regional_pricing_note: Play template auto-convert; premium tier intentionally never discounted anywhere
rc_entitlement: supporter + all_access (product attached to BOTH entitlements)
placement_context: shop dedicated card; never appears in any interrupt or failure flow (brief-locked)
contents: Everything in All Access + exclusive Founder livery + name-a-cat cameo (local rename shown on one commuter) + supporter badge
player_value_prop: Back a solo dev and own the founder edition
first_shown: Shop tab only, from first shop visit
audience_segment: fans and completionists incl. existing all_access owners
policy_notes: No donation framing - Play requires deliverable digital content; shop card switches to 'you own All Access - this adds Founder cosmetics' state to prevent double-sell complaints; cameo name stays local-only (no UGC moderation surface)

name: Sakura Line Theme
rc_entitlement: theme_sakura (also granted by cm_all_access and cm_supporter_pack)
placement_context: theme_preview live preview from wardrobe/map + shop
contents: Full Sakura visual theme: stations, tracks, trains, UI accents; color+symbol readability rules unchanged (colorblind-safe)
player_value_prop: Ride the blossom line - pure cosmetics, zero gameplay change
first_shown: Tapping the locked theme applies a live preview with buy or 3-level rewarded rental side by side
policy_notes: Cosmetic only; theme_rental rewarded rental (1/theme/day) must honor the full 3 levels even if connectivity drops mid-rental
experiment_priority: PW04 anchor role only - no theme price test (E09/E23 forbid repricing IAP themes)
award_relevance: Design + Catvertising (rental = an ad the player asks for)

name: Neon Line Theme
rc_entitlement: theme_neon (also granted by cm_all_access and cm_supporter_pack)
placement_context: theme_preview live preview from wardrobe/map + shop
contents: Full Neon visual theme: night-city reskin of stations, tracks, trains, UI accents; readability rules unchanged
player_value_prop: Run the midnight metro - pure cosmetics, zero gameplay change
first_shown: Same as Sakura: live preview with buy or 3-level rewarded rental
policy_notes: Cosmetic only; same rental rule as Sakura; verify neon palette passes colorblind check before ship
experiment_priority: PW04 anchor role only - no theme price test (E09/E23 forbid repricing IAP themes)

name: Rewind 5-Pack
rc_entitlement: none (consumable - durable local ledger, not an entitlement)
placement_context: rewind_failure sheet (purchase row rendered LAST) + shop
contents: 5 rewinds - each jumps the level back to your last safe decision tick
player_value_prop: Undo one wrong switch instead of replaying the level
first_shown: Rewind sheet on eligible failure only (attempt >= 2 on the level AND progress >= 40% AND a safe tick exists; never on first failure; no level floor); owned/free/rewarded options always listed above purchase
policy_notes: Never required: every level solvable free (locked positioning); grants deduped by SHA-256 hashed transaction id in the save-file ledger

name: Rewind 20-Pack
rc_entitlement: none (consumable - durable local ledger, not an entitlement)
contents: 20 rewinds - 37% cheaper per rewind than the 5-pack ($0.25 vs $0.40)
player_value_prop: Best value for players who like a safety net
first_shown: Same surfaces as cm_rewind_5; 'best value' badge placement governed by PW05
policy_notes: Same ledger and never-required rules as cm_rewind_5; badge copy must state the actual per-unit math

name: All Access $4.99 (PW01 experiment SKU)
regional_pricing_note: Play template tpl_cm_499 auto-converts from $4.99 USD; created Aug 1 (rc config D1-17) so Play propagation is never the blocker
rc_entitlement: all_access (+ theme_sakura + theme_neon attached BEFORE activation, only while PW01 runs)
rc_offering: ofr_core_b only - experiment-only offering, deleted after the PW01 readout
placement_context: post_level_5 variant arm only, while PW01 runs
contents: IDENTICAL to cm_all_access (Play prices are per-SKU, so a $4.99 arm needs its own SKU)
player_value_prop: Same as cm_all_access - this row exists for the price test, not as a separate product
first_shown: Never at launch: INACTIVE and out of every offering until PW01 starts; deactivated again at PW01 end
audience_segment: PW01 variant arm of post_level_5 traffic while the experiment runs
policy_notes: Experiment-only / INACTIVE at 1.0 - the D24-52 pre-submit sweep verifies cm_all_access_499 INACTIVE and the launch-day screenshot proves it was never sellable at 1.0
experiment_priority: PW01 price test $6.99 vs $4.99 (directional; pre-registered as non-significant at our scale)

name: Starter Pack (evaluated)
contents: CUT 2026-07-31: nothing coherent to bundle - no premium currency exists and themes sell better via live preview; would only have discounted content we want full-price
policy_notes: Cut rationale: discount-anchor packs conflict with the fair-by-design positioning and add SKU noise during a trust-led launch

name: Theme Duo Bundle (evaluated)
contents: CUT 2026-07-31 (brief-locked): decoy confusion against All Access - All Access IS the bundle
policy_notes: Cut rationale: a $4.99 two-theme bundle sits confusingly under the $6.99 everything tier and cannibalizes it

name: Ticket Packs (evaluated)
contents: CUT 2026-07-31 (brief-locked): tickets are client-side earn-only soft currency with cosmetic-only sinks; selling them creates pay-to-progress perception and server-liability for zero design benefit
policy_notes: Cut rationale: no premium currency is a locked economy decision; selling soft currency also breaks the 'nothing gameplay-gated' promise optics

name: Streak Saver IAP (evaluated)
contents: CUT 2026-07-31 (brief-locked): streak saving stays rewarded/free only - monetizing loss-aversion poisons trust and contradicts the streak_risk journey copy that promises progress is safe
policy_notes: Cut rationale: paid streak repair is the single most complained-about pattern in comp reviews; rewarded streak_saver (1/day) covers the need

name: District Chapter Packs (evaluated)
contents: CUT 2026-07-31 (brief-locked): districts folded into All Access; per-chapter gates fragment a 30-level campaign and multiply SKUs for pennies
policy_notes: Cut rationale: one clean complete-edition SKU beats six micro-gates for both HAMM narrative and player trust

name: Audio Pack (evaluated)
contents: CUT 2026-07-31: bespoke audio content is outside 8-week solo scope and comps show negligible willingness-to-pay for audio-only DLC
policy_notes: Cut rationale: production cost exceeds any plausible window revenue; base game ships one polished soundscape instead

name: Cosmetic Club Monthly (evaluated)
contents: CUT 2026-07-31 (brief-locked): ALL subscriptions rejected for launch and the event window - no recurring content cadence a solo dev can honestly sustain in 8 weeks
policy_notes: Cut rationale: an under-delivered subscription is a refund and review liability during judging; revisit post-event only if weekly District Cup cadence proves durable

name: Season Pass (evaluated)
contents: CUT 2026-07-31 (brief-locked): same recurring-content rejection as subscriptions; weekly District Cup mini-event stays free with a participation cosmetic
policy_notes: Cut rationale: pass tracks demand daily content ops and FOMO mechanics that contradict fair-by-design positioning

name: Founder Pack $19.99 Variant (evaluated)
contents: CUT 2026-07-31: a second premium tier splits a tiny payer base (2025 calibration: category awards won at 1k-13k users, $1k-2k revenue); cm_supporter_pack $9.99 already captures superfans
policy_notes: Cut rationale: revisit only if supporter attach outperforms; adding it mid-window would require new store review anyway

name: All Access via Web (Stripe funnel)
regional_pricing_note: Stripe Prices per-currency; match Play localized price to avoid channel arbitrage complaints
rc_offering: web funnel (RevenueCat Web Billing) redeemed in-app via Redemption Links
placement_context: external web funnel page -> Redemption Link deep link into app; Play now permits external billing US/UK/EEA (verified 2026-07-31)
contents: Same contents as cm_all_access, purchased on catmetro.io and redeemed in the Android app
player_value_prop: Buy on the web, keep 97% instead of 85% - powers the Stripe Funnel Vision entry
first_shown: Only via web funnel link in #BuildInPublic posts and site; never inside the app before go/no-go
policy_notes: P2 stretch (brief-locked): go/no-go Sep 4 (Day 35); requires RC Pro-plan Funnels + connected Stripe + Redemption Links; must not touch launch scope; judged on web payment volume
